action.objective: Verify d3e4 as the reserved top candidate: recapture the light-square bishop on e4 with the d3 pawn, opening the queen/rook lines and gaining central space.
action.rationale: Broad depth-1 search scored d3e4 best (13 exact) among all root moves; it wins the e4 bishop for the d-pawn on a square the queen (b3) and rook (c2) can support, and clears the d3 pawn for the d6 passed pawn. Black's queen on e5 and bishop on b6 remain active, so deeper verification is needed for king safety (Kg1 exposed on light squares) before committing. Using the full reserved 2000-node single-candidate verification at effective depth 4.
